% Does the cmyk option reach TikZ shadings? (pgf builds shadings in its own colour model.)
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[cmyk]{xcolor}
\usepackage{tikz}
\pagestyle{empty}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \shade[left color=cyan,right color=magenta] (0,0) rectangle (3,2);
  \shade[ball color=yellow] (5,1) circle (1);
\end{tikzpicture}
